description: A FACTUAL directory record for a court / tribunal, ingested from pre-published public records into the etzhayyim global judiciary corpus. R0 skeleton per ADR-2605302345 §D4. Stores jurisdiction, instance level, competence, procedure references, and the court's OWN published public contact / e-filing endpoint (used only as a counsel-operated transport target, never for autonomous filing — G18). Passive-only ingestion (danjo G3): pre-published public records only; no scraping behind authentication; no sealed / in-camera registries. Source-provenance mandatory (≥1 public CID). This record carries NO evaluation of the court and NO judge-analytics (G19 applies corpus-wide); it is a reference directory, not a ranking.

jurisdiction.description: ISO jurisdiction (country or subdivision), e.g. jpn / us-ca / fra.

instance.description: Factual instance level. NOT a quality ranking.

competence.description: Subject-matter competence as published (e.g. civil / criminal / administrative / family).

publicEndpoint.description: Court's OWN published public contact / e-filing endpoint. Transport target for counsel-operated acts ONLY (G18); never an autonomous-filing identity for the corp.

procedureRefCids.description: CIDs of published procedure rules for this court.

sourceRecordCids.description: ≥1 pre-published public-record CID (passive-ingestion provenance, danjo G3/G5).

passiveIngestion.description: Ingested from pre-published public records only — no live portal scraping (G3).
